content.title: Trails and Open Space
content.summary: Arvada features a comprehensive trail network exceeding 150 miles, comprising Primary, Local, and Regional Trails designed for non-motorized recreation and commuting. Additionally, the city's Parks and Open Space division oversees over 3,200 acres of non-irrigated land, maintaining approximately 1,350 acres of open space each growing season.
content.body:
![Ralston Creek trail sign next to a divided trail](/ImageRepository/Document?documentID=1818 "Ralston Creek trail sign next to a divided trail")

## Trails

Arvada's 150-plus-mile trail network consists of Primary, Local and Regional Trails with both paved and soft surfaces. Trails are suitable for non-motorized recreational enjoyment as well as commuting. More information on the City's trail network can be found in the sections below.

- [Parks and Open Space Trail Map](/DocumentCenter/View/607) (map only)
- [Parks and Open Space Trail Map and Guide](/DocumentCenter/View/4140/2023-Arvada-Parks-Trails-and-Open-Space-Map) (parks and trails map, list of parks and trail descriptions)
  - To get a printed version of the Trail Map and Guide, stop by the main entrance to City Hall (8101 Ralston Rd.) during business hours.
- [Primary Trails](/558)
- [Local Trails](/560)
- [Regional Trails](/866)
- [Trail Etiquette and Tips](/910)
- [Adopt-A-Trail](/564)
- [Snow Removal on Trails](/565)

## Open Space

The Arvada Parks and Open Space division maintains more than 3,200 acres of non-irrigated land throughout the City. Each growing season, our parks staff mows approximately 1,350 acres of open space areas bordered by hundreds of private properties.

- [General Open Space Information](/514)
- [Open Space and Natural Area Maintenance](/517)
